answer: Each identity claims one reef plot and locks an 80-credit bond. It files an echo transect of coral cover, signed by the plot key, so one transect cannot serve a second plot. An auditor recomputes cover against a summit datum and the echo table, burning the bond if filed cover differs by over 4%. The first survey costs 33 credits, the kth 33+9(k-1), the 1000th 9024; 1,000 fakes pay 4,528,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-transect ring fails because reused soundings lack the renter plot key and burn both bonds. An honest surveyor pays 33 once and recovers the bond after audit.
